text: {"verdict": "supported", "answer": "The evidence shows that blocking the H3K4 methyltransferase MLL1 with MM-401 reprograms mouse epiblast stem cells (EpiSCs) to naive pluripotency highly efficiently and synchronously (>50% within 3 days), with reverted cells reactivating the silenced X chromosome and contributing to germline-competent chimeras.
